metadata.body:
Adds PostgreSQL R2DBC conformance scenarios for the OpenTelemetry Java agent and `opentelemetry-r2dbc-1.0` library instrumentation. Both modes run the same reactive workload.

The scenarios cover plain statements, parameter binding, batches, stored procedures through the R2DBC `Statement` API, and handled SQL errors. They do not cover connection pooling, transactions, or cancellation.
metadata.title: Add PostgreSQL R2DBC conformance scenarios
